sentence: Competitive intensity strengthens the creational path from technological opportunism to competitive advantage
passage: [Li, Wu et al. (2026), p. 1] "competitive intensity amplifies the mediation effect of creational affordance instead of the mediation effects of organizational memory and collaborative affordances."
